description: The LLM labeled the fuel material source_variant_id='3B' while Facts declared the canonical variant id '3B_fuel' (the universe manifest derives fuel_variant_id from the same Facts). Universe qualification requires an exact match, so the materials normalizer must canonicalize the fuel source_variant_id against Facts. v16 generated materials monolithically, so the monolithic normalization path must receive state (Facts) for the canonicalization to fire.
